data.narrative:
Castelion is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Bryon Hargis, Sean Pitt, and Andrew Kreitz, with $100M raised to date and a last post-money valuation of $1.0B. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies across the sector: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $1.0B last post-money valuation, implying $2.0B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business scale and maturity within the Series A cohort.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $340M to $2.3B, with a median of $1.2B. The current $1.0B+ valuation sits near the lower bound of stage-progression guidance and well above peer-median, reflecting either premium positioning relative to the cohort or potential overvaluation relative to comparable transactions. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, customer concentration, and technology differentiation relative to named peers—factors that explain the wide peer valuation dispersion and warrant deeper due diligence.
